page.notes: The Latin in the first line and the abbreviation after "inserviendum" are uncertain. The "q" mark is a superscript sign, read as -que, and is marked [?]. "mediocriillustrentur" appears run together in the print and is copied as printed. The initial E is a large drop cap, joined to "Narratæ" as in the print. The marginal note is printed in small type across three lines with hyphens at the line ends, kept as printed. The heading's "Schola" carries a circumflex on the a, copied as printed.
